facts.function: drives the polygon/mirror of a laser bar code scanner
facts.form: complete DC brushless motor assembly, subcomponent

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8501 covers electric motors; Section XVI and Chapter 85 notes do not exclude it (note 2 excludes only goods of 8511/8512/8540-8542)
GRI 6: 8501.10 motors not exceeding 37.5 W (assumed, given size of scanner motor); 8501.10.40 under 18.65 W other; DC brushless statistical line

rejected_alternatives.reason: applies only if output is 18.65 W or more; a scanner motor is far smaller
larger DC motors above 37.5 W; unlikely for a scanner subcomponent
motor is a separate electric motor not a scanner itself; heading 8501 is specific

missing_facts: Rated output wattage of the motor (assumed under 18.65 W)
classification.rationale: A DC brushless motor assembly is an electric motor of heading 8501. Assuming output under 18.65 W, it falls in 8501.10.40.40 (DC brushless), consistent with in-force ruling H87929 on a DC brushless motor for displays.
